name: client-mosaic-columns
purpose: Three featured success stories side by side: each column is a client's mark on a face painted in the client's own brand colour, over a one-line story that links to the case. With `reveal="hover"` each column is one card instead: the client's reversed logo on its brand face, which opens while hovered or focused to reveal the story line and a "Read story" cue, the whole card linking to the case; below the large breakpoint those cards stack and stay open. It is a page section — the site places it from a `{ _id: 'client-mosaic-columns', props }` entry and binds `props` straight onto it — and it composes `section-module`, `frame-box` and `logo-wall`. The retired `'customer-spotlight'` `_id` resolves here with `reveal: 'hover'`.
useWhen: Use ClientMosaicColumns for three or four client cards in brand colours linking to case studies; `reveal="hover"` shows the story on hover.
avoidWhen: For a bento of client stories with photos and logos → use `client-mosaic`.
related: logo-wall` — the single-mark wall each column's face is rendered with.
bestPractices: Three cells for `reveal="always"` (the grid is three columns from the large breakpoint); three or four for `reveal="hover"`, which shares the row between them.
With `reveal="hover"` use the client's reversed (white) logo and one sentence per story; `logoWidth` sizes the mark as a share of the card (default `35%`).

Leave `brand` out for a client the client registry knows (`clientBrand(name)` from `@aziontech/webkit/assets/client-registry`): the face reads its colours, and its ink, by `name`. Add a missing client to the registry rather than writing its hex colours into the page.

Pass `brand` only for a one-off client the registry does not carry: `base` and `glow` may be any CSS colour, and `ink` is `'dark'` when the face is light enough that the link text must be dark. A cell with neither paints a black face.

props.name: anchor
props.doc: In-page id set on the band so a hash link can target it.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.doc: Accessible name of the list of stories.

props.name: linkLabel
props.doc: Label the mark face reveals on hover and the link's accessible name.

props.name: cells
props.doc: The stories, in order; each is `{ name, logo, href, story, brand?, logoTreatment?, logoWidth? }` where `brand` is `{ base, glow, ink? }` (CSS colours painting the face, `ink` `'dark'` or `'light'`) and defaults to the client registry's colours for `name`, `logoTreatment` is `'monochrome'`, `'knockout'` or `'as-is'`, and `logoWidth` (read by `reveal="hover"`) sizes the mark as a share of the card.

props.name: reveal
props.doc: When the story shows: `always` under each face, or `hover`, where each card opens to reveal it while hovered or focused and stays open below the large breakpoint.

<script setup>

  import ClientMosaicColumns from '@aziontech/webkit/client-mosaic-columns'

<template>
  <ClientMosaicColumns

    :cells="[

          'Dafiti modernized its digital architecture to deliver faster, scalable, and resilient experiences for millions of consumers across Latin America.',

      {
        name: 'MadeiraMadeira',

examples.name: Reveal on hover
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import agibankExtendedReversed from '@aziontech/webkit/assets/agibank-extended-reversed.svg'
  import americanasExtendedReversed from '@aziontech/webkit/assets/americanas-extended-reversed.svg'
  import arezzoExtendedReversed from '@aziontech/webkit/assets/arezzo-extended-reversed.svg'
  import ClientMosaicColumns from '@aziontech/webkit/client-mosaic-columns'

  const cells = [
    {
      name: 'Agibank',
      logo: agibankExtendedReversed,
      href: '/customers/agibank',
      story: 'Agibank moved its digital bank to a platform that scales with every campaign.'
    },
    {
      name: 'Americanas',
      logo: americanasExtendedReversed,
      href: '/customers/americanas',
      story: 'Americanas serves Black Friday traffic with no capacity planning.'
    },
    {
      name: 'Arezzo',
      logo: arezzoExtendedReversed,
      href: '/customers/arezzo',
      story: 'Arezzo cut image weight by half across its storefronts.'
    }
  ]
</script>

<template>
  <ClientMosaicColumns
    reveal="hover"
    :cells="cells"
  />
</template>
